Short title and commencement

ACT XI OF 1973
ACT XI OF 1973
PRISONERS (SIND
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act to amend
the Prisoners Act, 1900, in its application to the Province of Sind
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 29th June 1973]
(First published after having
received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the Gazette of Sind
(Extraordinary), dated 28th June 1973).
No. PAS/Legis-B-11/73.--The
Prisoners (Sind Amendment) Bill, 1973 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sind on the 11th June 1973 and assented to by the Governor of Sind
on the 27th June 1973 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of
Sind:-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Prisoners (Sind Amendment)
Act, 1973.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 29 of Act III of 1900

ACT XI OF 1973
ACT XI OF 1973
PRISONERS (SIND
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act to amend
the Prisoners Act, 1900, in its application to the Province of Sind
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 29th June 1973]
(First published after having
received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the Gazette of Sind
(Extraordinary), dated 28th June 1973).
No. PAS/Legis-B-11/73.--The
Prisoners (Sind Amendment) Bill, 1973 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sind on the 11th June 1973 and assented to by the Governor of Sind
on the 27th June 1973 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of
Sind:-
2. Amendment of section 29 of
Act III of 1900.---In the Prisoners Act, 1900, in its application to the
Province of Sind, in section 29, in sub-section (1)-
(i) in clause
(d), after the comma, the word "or" shall be added ; and
(ii) after
clause (d) as so amended, the following new clause shall be added, namely:-
"(e) as an
under-trial prisoner".
